title: GLACIAL. FIRE.
metaDescription: A 6.06-carat lab-grown oval flanked by two Fancy Intense Yellow pear shapes. By Bez Ambar, Los Angeles.
copy: A six-carat lab-grown oval at the center, framed by two Fancy Intense Yellow pear shapes — matched in colour, matched in cut geometry, chosen to read as one continuous piece. Lab-growth answers the problem three-stone has always had: same crystal chemistry, same colour saturation, same read across all three stones. The stone chosen first, the setting chosen for the stone — the maison's same principle since 1979.

specs.label: Gem Stones
specs.body: Center: 6.06 carats · Lab-grown oval · 14.91 × 10.2 mm. Sides: two Fancy Intense Yellow pear-shape lab-grown diamonds, 0.85 and 0.89 carats.

specs.label: Metal
specs.body: Available in 18K white gold, yellow gold, or rose gold. Also in platinum.

specs.label: Setting
specs.body: Three-stone setting with the oval center forward and the pear-shape sides angled to frame the length of the center stone. Detail available on inquiry.

specs.label: More Details
specs.body: Lab-grown fancy colour selected for consistent saturation across all three stones. Provenance certificate available on request.
